TA0058.title: AI Data Poisoners
TA0058.description: Attackers who influence model behavior by creating and injecting poisoned samples into AI training pipelines, often using crawlers or UI automation to scale delivery.

references.title: A small number of samples can poison LLMs of any size - Anthropic
